name: Husni Sarafi
summary: RPA Consultant at EY, managing BluePrism processes for a national utility provider's billing and metering operations. Three years spanning process delivery, RPA development, and enterprise consulting — started monitoring AutomationAnywhere robots at IBM, became a full RPA builder at E-Outsource, now delivering at scale with BluePrism. Self-taught developer outside work: AI meeting transcription, automotive UI, and smart home automation. Actuarial Science background; thinks in systems and probability. Exploring agentic AI as the next frontier beyond rule-based automation.

rows.Role: RPA Consultant — Associate, assigned to a national utility provider engagement. Managing and monitoring BluePrism processes across billing and advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) operations.
rows.Actions: Handles a portfolio of live BP processes including SMART Meter Billing and AMI data pipelines. Monitors robot health, triages failures, and ensures process stability across high-volume transactional workflows.

rows.Role: Associate Consultant — primary RPA developer. End-to-end ownership: process discovery, solution design, development, deployment, and post-launch monitoring across multiple client engagements.
rows.Actions: Designed and shipped LOMAS (Logistics Management System) automation — tracking import/export liners, updating shipment plans, integrating SQL databases and APIs into robot workflows. Built e-invoice pipeline extracting data from SAP ERP, transforming to IRBM-mandated format, uploading via middleware. Developed Excel macro scripts for Purchase Order processing with cross-checking against customer records and SAPGUI posting.

rows.Role: Process Delivery Specialist — Accounts Receivable, serving the Vietnamese market. Initially an end user, then assigned to monitor live AutomationAnywhere robots supporting the operations team.
rows.Actions: Observed how senior developers combined RPA with Excel macros to automate AR workflows — invoice processing, payment reconciliation, aging reports. Started experimenting with VBA, built scripts that caught the team's attention, and eventually contributed to live automation development.

projects.name: Meeting Min
projects.desc: Self-hosted bilingual meeting minutes bot. Captures audio from Microsoft Teams, pipes through Whisper for speech-to-text (auto-detects Malay and English), generates structured summaries via LLM. Designed for locked-down corporate environments — audio captured locally, processed on remote server via SSH tunneling.

projects.name: Mazda AIO
projects.desc: Custom speedometer dashboards and instrument cluster UIs for the Mazda Connect CMU head unit (2015 Mazda 2). Includes real-time driving data visualization and a React multi-screen app prototype. Exploration of embedded systems, CAN bus data, and automotive UI design on production hardware.

projects.name: Yeelight Backlight
projects.desc: Real-time monitor ambient lighting — captures screen edges, averages colors, sends commands to a Yeelight bslamp3 over LAN TCP. Iterated through 6 versions solving TCP buffer overflow (threaded sender + drop queue), temporal smoothing, dark mode fallback, and adaptive rate limiting.

projects.name: Celestial Clock
projects.desc: Full-screen canvas rendering a prayer-synced sky — gradients tied to actual Islamic prayer times (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) via Aladhan API. Features sun arc, moon with phase rendering, twinkling stars, and layered mountain silhouettes.

projects.name: Bursa Sector Catalyst
projects.desc: Sector-based catalyst analysis model for Bursa Malaysia. Applies actuarial probability thinking to stock market sector rotation patterns. Early research phase — stalled in favor of active RPA work and AI exploration.
